notes.title: Tiny Tanks v0.3.0 Changelogs
notes.content:
Tiny Tanks v0.3.0 Changelogs
2024.09.04

New Contents
New Levels
- Added Level 1-9：Crevice and Level 1-10：Field of Airstrike
BOSS FIGHT！
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005258/d5ef1f43d4633dcd9c43700806dac36d878316ba.gif
- First ever boss fight in Tiny Tanks! This is going to be the final level of chapter 1 as well.
- You will encounter General Williams, a tough foe who calls airstrikes upon players!
- After defeating General Williams, you will acquire his weapon.
New Weapon: Airstrike
Unlock by completing achievement "Airstrike Interceptor".
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005258/f4a6ff43a155809b79922bfe01012d75104ec583.png
New Weapon: Yin-Yang
Unlock by completing achievement "Duality".
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005258/e7e262a928823bbb05e8caa3cb6ed4084ccbae30.png
New Weapon: Boombox
Unlock by completing achievement "Audiophile".
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005258/414abf43a822759a23bb4f02659695ddabb9a1ce.png

Gameplay Changes
Introducing BGM
- Different scenes will have different background music, so try them all!
Enemy AI Changes
- The accuracy of enemy fire will depend on the distance to the target.
- The enemy will adjust the orientation of the tank to the direction of the target before firing.

Bugfixes
- Fixed an issue that the pause menu can be buggy in the Shooting Range sometimes.
- Fixed an issue that enemy tanks can sometimes face wrong directions.
- Fixed an issue that the game will throw an error during Discord connection failures.
- Fixed an issue with the outline of Level 1-6.
- Fixed an issue that the weapon-unlock popup may not show up after exiting from the battle scene.

notes.title: Tiny Tanks v0.2.3 Changelogs
notes.content:
TINY TANKS v0.2.3 CHANGE LOGS
Aug 5, 2024

New Features
Improved Shooting Range scene
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005258/6572bc1d16fd4b0226f710347689e1a4829e0983.gif
- Shooting range now has metal tiles that cannot be destroyed by most weapons
- Introduction of flying enemies (flying targets).
New Weapon: Piggy Bank
Unlocked by completing achievement "Earned a Bit".
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005258/0d74561e16819a20760c3d7433f20f91b787459e.png

Gameplay Improvements
Enemy AI Changes
- Enemies now have a higher tendency to walk towards the player.
- Enemies will stop moving when they are about to hit a wall.
- Enemies will stop moving immediately when they are about to fall off a cliff.

Balance Changes
- Significantly decreased Saw Blade's aim (468 -> 368)
- Moderately decreased blast range of Shotgun projectiles (1.7 -> 1.5)
- Significantly decreased base damage of Portal Ball (20 -> 15)
- Moderately decreased base damage of Boomerang (32 -> 29)

User Interface (UI) Enhancements
- Added translations for the remaining weapons (saw blade, coconut seed, etc.)
- Adjusted the size of the top-left panel when you are in a match.
- Adjusted the position of tutorial prompts on wider screens.
- The "shop is empty" notice will appear directly when the player buys the last item in the shop.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug that the weapon Dice cannot roll a 6 sometimes.
- Fixed a bug that the weapon Puzzle cannot get the purple piece sometimes.
- Fixed an issue that the weapon Double Edged Sword won't punish the player when it is thrown out of the map.
- Fixed a bug that enemies will sometimes clip into the map.
- Fixed a bug that high-speed projectiles cannot collide with the map borders correctly.
- Fixed a bug that small fireballs created by weapon Fireball may go through the map directly.
- Fixed a bug that Portal Ball doesn't detonate immediately when it is teleported underground.
- Fixed the collider of some projectiles, making them explode upon direct enemy hits.
- Fixed an issue that the shockwaves from weapon Star's Comet Cascade cannot be displayed correctly.
- Fixed an issue that the player keeps sliding when fuel runs out.
- Fixed an issue that achievements sometimes cannot be displayed.

notes.title: Tiny Tanks v0.2.2 Changelogs
notes.content:
Level Changes

Re-done level 1-6 and renamed it to "Up and Down".

UI Changes

Added an "Achievements" tab that shows all the achieved / non-achieved achievements in the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005258/c11f64733f10339f5d62a383150eb2264e951151.gif

A "NEW" label is displayed for newly unlocked weapons in the Arsenal Page

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005258/682dd1a23dd8c0bb1eb33bb361847c76bc363dd2.gif'

Introduced "Weapon Extra Display" system for some weapons

For Gear, the game displays the number of effective gears in the current map

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005258/3ad48af0b2a665118e707f4234b6a74794445259.gif

For Puzzle, the games shows the completion status of the whole puzzle

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005258/c380da908139ee8e08638178c6159da214097b7f.gif

Other UI Changes

 Tooltip position is fixed on screens with wider resolutions
 Buff panel is displayed a little bit closer to the enemies
 Extra notice panel will show up when the shop is empty


New Weapons

New weapon: Puzzle (Hidden in the maps)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005258/b7ec1d08c10b62b900591ba20af1cbbe3c41de79.png

New weapon: Splitter (Currently unlocked in shop)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005258/38ba1c7163f82e01518a5438654b3ab267de2b05.png

New weapon: Packed Stone (Unlocked with achievement "Pack them up")

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005258/d27bb73940395943e580280a81576e4715256ceb.png

Miscellaneous Changes


 Updated the upgrade prices of the weapon Gear.
 When the Star projectile finishes drawing a star, a random deviation angle is applied to its velocity.
 Reduced blast radius of boulder by 30%.
 Fixed the borders of some maps.
 Fixed an issue where buffs don't have an effect during their last turn.
 Totally localized achievements

notes.title: Tiny Tanks v0.2.0 Changelog
notes.content:
UI Changes
Brand New UI!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005258/c991111faf9579baf093313f78443abc2d098e43.gif

With this big update, all pages in the main menu is getting a massive change in appearance.

Better Shop Interface

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005258/7e25e4161f696d18191aa59fe5d6034f26bd4874.gif

The shop page looks totally different now. Clicking on a weapon in this menu will bring up separate dialogs containing details about this weapon to confirm your purchase.

In-game User Interface

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005258/e71974f5393f8b2ba28852b4f914d83f95c82b34.gif

In-game UI is updated as well, having the same style as Main Menu. It now has a much better pause menu too.

Redesigned Arsenal Page

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005258/3b8fad966d2a11ff96f7e62cf3688dcc0abda7c2.gif

The arsenal page is having a new design too, with the selection panel now sitting in the bottom left corner.

Buff Tooltip

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005258/3200ff66cfddea5a9d63d5a3f1327c820da1f763.gif

Players can hover over the buff icon for detailed information about the applied buff, including the duration of the buff.

Other UI changes


 Fixed an issue where the tooltip panel is not correcting showing up for the first time.
 Added an animated loading screen when loading between scenes.


Weapon Changes
New weapon - Gear

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005258/6cbe644c0d5766073b695d8da254db3055a6b59d.png

Miscellaneous

 Discord Rich Presence: When players are in the main menu scene, it will only show that they are "Browsing Menu".
 Saves player data whenever a change occurs, not just on page switches.

notes.title: Tiny Tanks v0.1.4 Changelog
notes.content:
UI Changes

Better In-game Weapon Selection Panel

Instead of using a static 5-button panel at the bottom of your screen, Tiny Tanks is not having a much better and interactive selection panel when you are in a match.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005258/1fe54f0be29cea277eaa3d6ef46c43d1e46a13ee.gif

Highlighting the weapon magnifies the buttons, and the selected button will be larger than the others.

Revamped Level Selection Menu

After you select a chapter, the level selection menu is now displaying long buttons containing the name and preview of each level.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005258/9fe5e2811e0d2315e984d80688c474435dd917c2.gif

Improved Enemy Health Bars

While enemies are moving, the health bar is not flickering anymore. Also changed the bar's appearance to make it more visible.

Buff icons are also getting a small shadow for increased visibility.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005258/0c24a3d756324cb4a6d1032388e53f2e956c89cd.gif

Weapons


 Molotov is now unlocked by completing the achievement "Spread the Fire".
 Anvil projectiles won't collide with entities now.
 Star is now unlocked by finding the secret treasure in level 1-5.
